posts.text: We’re hiring a Data Analyst on my team at StarTech.com (London, ON)! If you enjoy digging into data, building dashboards, and turning insights into business impact, this is a great opportunity. You’ll get to work across supply chain, product, and market intelligence analytics with lots of variety in the work. If this sounds like you (or someone you know), I’d love for you to apply or feel free to message me directly. I would also appreciate any shares to help us find a great fit 🙌 #StarTech.com
